orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Concord Thruster Mk3, a hull mount (outward is up): the Mk2 twin amber-ringed bells plus a third, smaller vernier nozzle between them, a coolant drum with a pipe on each flank, and inside the Mk2 core plus a coolant pump (gauge and drum) in place of the feed pipes and a cable harness across the middle. Damaged: the left bell lip dented and hanging, the right bell cracked and sputtering, the vernier bent over and weeping coolant, a drum cracked; the pump gauge reads red, sparks at the hatch and coupling. Disabled: the left nozzle snapped off at the neck, the right bent over, the vernier broken off, a drum split; the core dead with its repair hatch popped. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
